about: The draws of the diagnostics' witness cases (docs/specs/bayes-diagnostics.md, «Witnesses»), written by make_cases.py; every value at 8 significant digits, a case's draws a list of chains.

cases.name: iid
cases.pins: i.i.d. normal draws, 4 x 1,000: R-hat near 1, ESS near S

cases.name: ar1_09
cases.pins: AR(1) with rho = 0.9, 4 x 1,000: the autocorrelation sum and its truncation

cases.name: shifted
cases.pins: one chain of four shifted by one sd: R-hat of the location (bulk)

cases.name: scaled
cases.pins: one chain of four with four times the scale: the folded R-hat (tail) that the bulk misses

cases.name: cauchy
cases.pins: standard Cauchy draws, 4 x 1,000: the rank normalization where the moments do not exist

cases.name: ties_two_values
cases.pins: 1,000.12345 + 0.00001 z at 8 significant digits: two values almost only (average ranks)

cases.name: ties_coarse
cases.pins: 1,000 + 0.001 z, AR(1) rho = 0.3, at 8 significant digits: 288 distinct values, a step of 1e-5 below 1,000 and 1e-4 above (average ranks)

cases.name: odd
cases.pins: an odd number of draws, 4 x 999, AR(1) rho = 0.3: the split's middle draw

cases.name: one_chain
cases.pins: one chain of 1,000, AR(1) rho = 0.5: the split of a single chain

cases.name: antithetic
cases.pins: AR(1) with rho = -0.6, 4 x 1,000: the improved tau estimate of an antithetic chain

cases.name: skewed_atom
cases.pins: gamma(0.5) draws with 2 % of them exactly 0: a skewed quantity with an atom at its minimum

cases.name: atom_top
cases.pins: beta(5, 1) draws with 8 % of them exactly 1: an atom above the 95 % quantile (the upper tail's indicator)

cases.name: short
cases.pins: 2 x 7 draws, split chains of 3: the shortest autocorrelation sum (no pair after the first)

cases.name: too_short
cases.pins: 4 x 5 draws, split chains of 2: fewer than 3 draws a split chain (the contract's NULLs)

facts.name: sampler
facts.pins: divergent__, treedepth__ and energy__ of a fake run of 4 x 1,000: the facts and E-BFMI
